causal_limitations: E4G remains rejected under its original joint decision; this diagnostic cannot retroactively relax that gate.
The fresh both-order E4G minus V7 gain is 5/48 with paired 95% bootstrap CI [0,11], so a strictly positive independent gain is not established.
E4G order invariance is 12/26 = 0.462 and V7 order invariance is 7/16 = 0.438; neither checkpoint demonstrates order-robust rule execution.

The record-level E4G gain is substantially larger when frame color is numerically smaller than inner color (+12) than under the reversed numeric relation (+3), so shortcut sensitivity remains material.
This diagnostic isolates color ordering, demo order, and controlled structure more strongly than E4G, but it is still one synthetic family and is not an ARC-AGI-2 benchmark claim.

next_experiment.control: Exact V7 initialization with the original E4G optimizer/update/replay budget and the original narrow order-A/color-ordered Inside/Contains primary curriculum.
next_experiment.hypothesis: The apparent E4G benefit is dominated by training-curriculum shortcuts; counterbalancing demo order and color-role assignments while preserving the same semantic operator will improve both-order counterfactual OOD transfer.
next_experiment.primary_difference: Treatment replaces only the Inside/Contains primary slots with an oracle-validated, order-balanced and color-role-counterbalanced curriculum; all replay, optimizer, updates, seed, token budget, decoder, and evaluation conditions remain matched.
required_outcomes: fresh both-order native-Greedy exact-grid gain over matched control with paired lower CI strictly above zero
